answer: Here is one mechanism that works: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because signal only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, hollow is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any dawn approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
